name: Repair Hull

automation.text: A vehicle you touch regains a number of Hit Points equal to 4d12 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. The target vehicle must have 1 HP or more to be affected.

subclasses: Occultist Monster Hunter, Sanguine Thief Rogue, Spellslinger Gunslinger, Arcane Hand Monk, Arcane Hand Monk
description: A vehicle you touch regains a number of Hit Points equal to 4d12 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. The target vehicle must have 1 HP or more to be affected.
higherlevels: The damage increases by 1d12 for each spell level above 3rd.
